slug: 2025-10-13 Somalia moves to finalize Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030 with ITU support

facts.fact: Ecofin reports that the Ministry of Communications and Technology, with the ITU, hosted a two-day national multi-stakeholder consultation on 12-13 October 2025 'to validate' Somalia's Digital Transformation Strategy (2025-2030), reviewing and refining the 'proposed' roadmap; no adoption is reported.

The article gives the strategy's period as 2025-2030, and as_of 2025-10-12 falls inside it; it does not link or quote the text, and a corroborating note says the consultation was to gather input before adoption. Text public: not stated

systems.tiers: national; named as the predecessor the new strategy builds on
national; the strategy is said to align with it

note: Class national is read from the Minister's statement that the strategy will be a national framework for all ICT-related initiatives across sectors, with pillars on broadband, cybersecurity and skills.
